title: Systematic benchmarking of local and global explainable AI methods for tabular healthcare data
core_idea: Present a comprehensive benchmarking framework to evaluate the quality of explanations produced by local and global XAI methods on tabular healthcare data by combining predictive model-centered evaluation (how well explanations capture model behavior) and human-centered evaluation (alignment with expert clinical reasoning), and apply it to a stroke prediction dataset across multiple predictive models and XAI methods.
tldr: A framework to systematically benchmark local and global XAI methods on tabular healthcare data using both model-centered and human-centered evaluations, demonstrated on a stroke prediction dataset with diverse models and explanation techniques to inform selection of clinically meaningful XAI-method/model pairs.
